name: Explore
description: Explore is an inspiration page with three sections: Trending Templates, a Prompt Library of 12 ready-to-try image prompts, and Browse by Category.
shortDescription: Inspiration: trending templates, 12 sample prompts, category cards.
fullDescription: Explore (route #/explore) is headed "Explore" with the line "Discover curated prompts, trending templates, and creative inspiration". It has three sections. "Trending Templates" shows the first 8 templates of the template library as cards (TikTok Video Creator, Instagram Reel Generator, YouTube Thumbnail, Reaction Thumbnail, Short-Form Ad, Story Highlight Cover, Profile Picture Generator, Banner Creator); clicking one opens that template in the Template Studio. "Prompt Library" shows 12 curated prompts, each labelled with a category and a model name and a "Try this prompt" button that opens Image Studio with the prompt pre-filled. "Browse by Category" shows a card per template category with a template count. The old Community page now redirects to Explore. Explore does not generate anything itself.
bestFor: Getting ideas, copying a good starting prompt into Image Studio, or jumping into a popular template.
whenToUse: You do not know what to make yet.
You want a proven starting prompt for Image Studio.
You want to open one of the most popular templates quickly.
whenToUseAnother: To see every tool, use Apps (#/apps).
To search or filter the full template catalog (categories and industry niches), use Templates (#/templates).
To write your own prompt from scratch, go straight to Image Studio (#/image).
keyFeatures: Trending Templates: 8 template cards with thumbnail, name and description.
Prompt Library: 12 curated prompts with category and model labels.
"Try this prompt" button that pre-fills Image Studio.
Browse by Category: a card per template category with its template count.

featureExplanations.explanation: The first 8 templates in the library. Click a card to open it in the Template Studio at #/template/<template id>.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Fast route into popular formats like TikTok videos or thumbnails.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: None to open; the template then asks for its own inputs.
featureExplanations.restrictions: The 8 shown are fixed by library order, not live popularity data.

featureExplanations.explanation: 12 curated image prompts. Each shows "Category / model" (for example "Cinematic / nano-banana") above the prompt. Press "Try this prompt" to save the prompt for Image Studio and navigate there.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Gives you a well-formed prompt to learn from or tweak.
featureExplanations.restrictions: The prompt text is pre-filled into Image Studio; the model label is informational. Check the model selected in Image Studio before you press Generate.

featureExplanations.explanation: One card per template category. The card shows the category name and "N templates".
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To see which template categories exist.
featureExplanations.restrictions: In the current code, clicking a category card opens the Apps hub (#/apps), not a filtered template list. Use Templates and its filter chips to filter by category.

howToUse: 1. Open Explore from the left side menu. 2. To use a prompt, find one in Prompt Library and click "Try this prompt"; Image Studio opens with the prompt filled in. 3. To use a template, click a card under Trending Templates. 4. In the destination studio, press Generate.
howToSteps: Open Explore from the left side menu.
Scroll to Prompt Library and click "Try this prompt" on one you like.
In Image Studio check the prompt and the selected model, then press Generate.
Or click a Trending Templates card to open it in the Template Studio.
gettingStarted: Click "Try this prompt" on any prompt card to see a full image workflow in a couple of clicks.
Make sure your MuAPI key is saved so generation works.
outputs: Navigation: opens Image Studio with a pre-filled prompt, or a template in Template Studio.
limitations: Explore has no search box or filters.
Category cards do not filter templates.
Trending is a fixed list, not live statistics.

limitationDetails.limitation: Category cards open the Apps hub
limitationDetails.impact: You may expect a filtered template list.
limitationDetails.workaround: Go to Templates (#/templates) and click a category chip such as "Social Media".

limitationDetails.impact: Industry categories (Restaurant & Cafe, Med Spa, Salon & Beauty, Fitness & Training, Real Estate, Dental, Chiropractic, Legal, Automotive, Fashion, Events, Luxury, Industry) are listed but are counted from the 52 standard templates only, so they show "0 templates".
limitationDetails.workaround: Open Templates and use the Industry filters there to see the niche templates.

troubleshooting: Prompt did not appear in Image Studio: open Explore again and press "Try this prompt"; paste the prompt manually into the Image Studio box.
Category shows 0 templates: expected for industry categories; use Templates.
Template card opens "Template not found": go to Templates and pick another card.

troubleshootingSteps.issue: Try this prompt opens Image Studio but the box is empty
steps: Copy the prompt text from Explore.
Paste it into the Image Studio prompt box.

commonProblems.problem: Category card sends me to Apps
commonProblems.whyItHappens: Category cards link to the Apps hub in the current version.

exampleWorkflows.title: Make an image from a curated prompt
steps: In Prompt Library choose "Cyberpunk street market at night, neon signs, rain reflections, detailed".

exampleWorkflows.title: Open a trending template
steps: Upload your photo, describe the video, press Generate.

useCases.title: Find prompt inspiration
useCases.description: Read 12 examples covering cinematic, sci-fi, art, lifestyle, fashion, fantasy, commercial, nature and style looks.
useCases.expectedOutput: An image generated from the curated prompt.

[Fashion / nano-banana] Fashion editorial, model in avant-garde geometric dress, studio lighting 7. [Fantasy / nano-banana] Ancient temple ruins overgrown with jungle, volumetric light rays 8. [Commercial / nano-banana] Product photo of luxury perfume bottle on marble, golden hour light 9. [Nature / flux-dev] Underwater coral reef with tropical fish, crystal clear water, natural light 10. [Sci-Fi / nano-banana] Steampunk clockwork city with airships, brass and copper tones, detailed 11. [Nature / nano-banana] Minimalist Japanese garden, zen stones, morning mist, peaceful atmosphere 12. [Style / nano-banana] GTA V loading screen style illustration of a man with sunglasses in Miami

faqs.question: What does Try this prompt do?
faqs.answer: It stores the prompt for Image Studio and opens Image Studio so it can be pre-filled.

faqs.question: Which templates are Trending?
faqs.answer: TikTok Video Creator, Instagram Reel Generator, YouTube Thumbnail, Reaction Thumbnail, Short-Form Ad, Story Highlight Cover, Profile Picture Generator and Banner Creator.

faqs.question: What happened to Community?
faqs.answer: The Community page was retired and its link now opens Explore.

glossary.Prompt: The text that describes what you want generated.
glossary.Template: A pre-configured generator for a specific look or format.
glossary.nano-banana / flux-dev: Model names shown on prompt cards.

tips: Edit the pre-filled prompt: swap the subject but keep the lighting and style words.
Try the same prompt with a different model in Image Studio to compare.
bestPractices: Use curated prompts as patterns: subject, setting, lighting, style.

relatedStudioGuidance.whenToMove: You want to filter or search templates.
relatedStudioGuidance.why: Templates has search and category/industry filters.

notConfirmed: Which model is actually selected in Image Studio after Try this prompt is not set by Explore; only the prompt text is handed over.
